## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector performance (Energy strong, Financials weak) and major stock divergences (several large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M), leadership concentrated rather than broad.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.42%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare steady: LLY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND, SYK (1W: +7.91% | 1M: -6.09%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (Tech-leaning among top performers but Energy present).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: FCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -16.36%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -12.20% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft: BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND. Sector Weakness evident across cyclicals outside Energy.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +2.12%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +8.92% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Tech-heavy with Energy and Consumer Disc showing strength).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NEM (1W: -12.20% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.21% | 1M: -16.58%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -16.36%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND, DD (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -0.54%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +2.12%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND. Watch divergence: AMD (1W: -7.64% | 1M: +50.59%) CORRECTION and INTC (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +68.65%) CORRECTION — major divergence among large-cap semiconductors.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, leaning CORRECTION/rotation. AAPL (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +9.18%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +2.37% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY, META (1W: -0.06% | 1M: -10.18%) BELOW TREND. Tech: Internal rotation; watch semiconductor divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft and uneven. JPM (1W: -3.01% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +1.07% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND. Financials: Sector Weakness; limited leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed but constructive in pockets. LLY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.56% | 1M: -0.30%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +20.33%) CORRECTION. Healthcare: Internal rotation with selective strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective Energy and strong Tech names showing clear momentum (XOM, CSCO, PANW) and monitor major semiconductor divergences; reduce exposure to Materials and lagging Industrials. Style mixed / no clear leadership; treat recent big-cap divergences as tactical signals rather than broad regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to confirm. BEARISH: AMD (1W: -7.64% | 1M: +50.59%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +68.65%) CORRECTION, BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (strong 1W leadership, XOM/OXY/EOG ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Materials and Industrials (broad weakness among miners and builders). Technology: watch for rotation within the sector amid semiconductor dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +9.18%) CORRECTION — watch for hold above recent 1M support to confirm continuation. CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND — sustained break above the week high would confirm follow-through. XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND — continued strength on rising oil signals carry-over.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
D (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +9.50%) ABOVE TREND (+90): Merger headline; price rising — sentiment confirmed. CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND (+60): HSBC target hike; price confirming. BA (1W: -9.23% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND (+65): China buyer headline but price falling — divergence, distribution risk.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (1W: -6.77% | 1M: +2.96%) CORRECTION (-50): FSD safety headline aligns with short-term weakness. HD (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -13.83%) BELOW TREND (-45): earnings/profit caution confirmed by price. UNH (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +20.33%) CORRECTION (-45): stake exit headline versus strong 1M gains — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CSCO (1W: +16.21% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (AMD, INTC, NVDA, plus mixed sentiment on BA/UNH) — monitor for trend break before shifting positioning.
